claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,333,000 ADA, consisting of 3,300,000 ADA for delivery and 33,000 ADA for a 1% administration fee.
Dano Finance will deliver a public DeFi Kernel registry, a Spot Leverage Order Book, an American Options Market-Making protocol, and a Composable DeFi Transaction Builder SDK.
The DeFi Kernel is intended to provide an open, fee-free, royalty-free compatibility standard for permissionless, composable, and discoverable Cardano DeFi contracts.
Dano Finance currently has approximately USD 18 million in TVL and more than 10,000 on-chain transactions.
The Spot Leverage Order Book will support leveraged spot trading intent involving collateral, borrowing, debt accounting, swap execution, risk parameters, and settlement.

The American Options protocol will use an extended concentrated-pool model to support pool-priced American options with strike, expiry, premium, collateral or exposure, exercise conditions, settlement, and LP risk accounting.

The SDK will help wallets, bots, indexers, market makers, and dApps discover DeFi Kernel-compatible contracts, read registry metadata, construct transactions, and compose with order book and options contracts.

The proposal sets KPIs of at least USD 1,000,000 rolling 30-day trading volume for the Spot Leverage Order Book and at least USD 1,000,000 rolling 30-day option notional volume within 90 days of mainnet launch, measured using public on-chain data.
Smart contract workstreams include security review or audit before mainnet release, and unresolved critical security issues block affected mainnet milestones.

Dano Finance will return 5% of protocol fees generated by the Treasury-funded Spot Leverage Order Book and American Options contracts for 12 months after mainnet launch, calculated after direct transaction costs, refunds, or protocol-level settlement costs, and reported publicly.

summary: The document presents a large treasury request for open DeFi registry infrastructure, two production DeFi primitives, and SDK tooling, with milestone descriptions, KPIs, budget allocation, Minswap Labs administration, security-review conditions, and a limited 12-month fee-return commitment.
